```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(1984)
```


```{r}
# Load the data
# https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/logandonaldson/sports-stadium-locations/data/stadiums.csv
stads = read_csv(paste0(getwd(), "/../../temp/stadiums.csv"))
stads$League = factor(stads$League)
```

```{r}
map = leaflet(data=stads) |>
      addTiles()  |>
      addMarkers(
        lat=stads$Lat,
        lng=stads$Long,
        popup=paste0(stads$Team, " - ", stads$League),
        group=stads$League,
        clusterOptions=markerClusterOptions()
      ) 
map
```
